fields.value: Monsoon Traders - 18th Century Makassar Shipping Data

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains data on non-European ships calling at the port of Makassar (now on Sulawesi, Indonesia) during the 18th century. It documents cargo, armament, crew, ownership, ship-type, and much more.
